subject: Edge Telemetry Alliance - kickoff and co-delivery next steps
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@observops.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@datadog.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa@grafana.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed kickoff: Edge Telemetry Alliance (ObservOps + Datadog + Grafana + Redwood)

Hi Kimberly, Samir, Alyssa —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. ObservOps has been piloting a small edge-agent that forwards OTLP to a multi-tenant relay and we think theres a clear joint opportunity to position a co-delivered "Edge Telemetry" offering: ObservOps builds the lightweight agent + policy pack, Redwood provides a turnkey ingestion route and model-informed routing, Datadog and Grafana provide visibility/synthesis.

I attached a brief spec (edge-telemetry-spec.pdf) and an initial SOW outline. High-level asks from our side:
- Alignment on supported OTLP signal types and sampling defaults
- Agreement on co-sell GTM motion and referral credits
- A simple runbook for integration validation and alerting ownership

Would love to get a 60-min kickoff this week to scope deliverables and ownership. Proposed times: Thu 12/17 11:00am PT or Fri 12/18 9:00am PT.

Cheers,

Marta Ruiz
Head of Partnerships, ObservOps
M: +1 415 555 0192
(attachment: edge-telemetry-spec.pdf (PDF))

Thanks Marta — great to see the spec. Thu 12/17 11:00am PT works for Redwood; Ive added Vanessa and Marissa from our partnerships and product teams.

Pre-kickoff asks from Redwood:
- A short matrix of expected ingest volumes (events/sec) across typical edge deployments (small/med/large)
- Any non-negotiable data residency or retention constraints for pilot customers
- Confirmation that Datadog and Grafana are comfortable with an initial limited-feature telemetry schema (we can iterate)

If you can share the SOW before the call that would be helpful. Ill send a calendar invite for Thu and include a short agenda.

Best,

Kimberly Park

Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 08:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed kickoff: Edge Telemetry Alliance (ObservOps + Datadog + Grafana + Redwood)

Kimberly, Marta —

Were in for Thu 11am PT. Quick notes from Datadog side so the kickoff is productive:
- Datadog can ingest OTLP traces/metrics/logs; primary ask is a stable sample header for traces from the agent so we can correlate across functions.
- For pilot customers we prefer 30d retention for test data; production retention terms can be negotiated via the usual sales channel.
- Wed like to propose a joint validation script that checks end-to-end tag preservation and trace continuity (we can bring a draft to the call).

Attaching a short checklist we use in partner integrations (attachment: datadog-integration-checklist.pdf).

Thanks,
Samir
Partner Solutions, Datadog
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 13:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: prep notes for ObservOps kickoff

Folks — thanks for adding me to this thread. I joined the kickoff and took notes (see below). Key action items we should own:

1) Integration contract boundaries
- Redwood: provide the ingestion routes, Handle model-informed routing, maintain KV cache mapping for edge-origin traces
- ObservOps: agent binary, policy pack, initial pilot customers
- Datadog / Grafana: visualization dashboards and co-branded quickstart

2) Technical requirements called out during kickoff
- Must support OTLP v0.17; optional: OTLP/HTTP fallback
- Sampling header: x-edge-sample-id (Datadog wants stable across restarts)
- TLS + mTLS for relay -> Datadog ingest endpoints

3) Commercial / GTM
- ObservOps proposes 20% referral credit on net new revenue for referrals in first 12 months
- Redwood to propose co-sell slide deck and a 1-pager by 12/22

4) Next steps / owners
- Kimberly: draft co-sell motion and send to partners (due 12/22)
- Karthik: scoped runbook for integration validation (due 1/7)
- Jonas: measure perf targets for 95th percentile tail latency for relayed requests (due 1/7)

Referenced attachments: co-delivery-sow-v1.docx, integration-runbook.md

-Marissa
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@observops.com>

Thanks Marissa, Kimberly — this is exactly the clarity we needed. Ive uploaded an updated SOW and a short runbook draft to the shared drive (see links below) and added a narrow pilot target list (three customers) for early Jan.

Weve also included a short SOC2 excerpt and basic dataflow diagram per your security ask (attachment: co-delivery-sow-v1.docx). For Datadog: we can include the sampling header and ensure the ObservOps agent preserves it across restarts; for Grafana wed like guidance on recommended dashboards for edge health metrics.

Proposed immediate commitments:
- Redwood: co-sell 1-pager due 12/22 (Kimberly)
- Karthik: integration runbook draft due 1/7 (Karthik)

- Co-sell credit: Redwood is fine with a referral credit model for the pilot; legal will need to draft a simple MOU (target by 1/10).
